name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  induction post <;> simp [substOld]
  case fvar =>
    intros x Hin
    simp_all
  case op | const | bvar =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans
      apply cih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans
      apply tih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    · apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split
      · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset]
      · assumption
    · simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, imp_false, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
      apply List.Subset.app
      · apply List.Subset.trans
        apply ih1 <;> assumption
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
        cases Hin <;> simp_all
      · apply List.Subset.trans
        apply ih2 <;> assumption
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
  case quant ih1 ih2 | eq ih1 ih2 =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih1 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    · apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih2 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have cat {a b c d : List CoreIdent} (h : a.Subset c)
      (k : b.Subset d) :=
    List.Subset.app (fun x hx => List.mem_append_left _ (h hx))
      (fun x hx => List.mem_append_right _ (k hx))
  intro h
  induction h with
  | const | op | bvar | fvar => simp only [extractOldExprVars, List.Subset.empty]
  | abs _ ih => assumption
  | quant _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact cat ih₁ ih₂
  | app _ _ hn ihfn ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact fun ⦃a⦄ a_1 => a_1
    · next Hfalse =>
        exfalso
        cases hn .oldPred
        apply Hfalse
        rfl
    · exact cat ihfn ihe
  | ite _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ => exact cat (cat ih₁ ih₂) ih₃
  | eq _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact cat ih₁ ih₂

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  have Hlen := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  have Hzip : (ks.zip vs).unzip.1.Disjoint (ks'.zip vs').unzip.1 := by
    rw [List.unzip_zip Hlen, List.unzip_zip (InitStatesLength Hinit)]
    intro k hk hk'
    simpa [InitStatesNotDefined Hinit k hk'] using
      (UpdateStatesDefined Hup k hk)
  have Hupdate := updatedStatesUpdate (σ:=updatedStates σ ks' vs') Hlen
    (updatedStatesDefMonotone (σ:=σ) (ves:=ks'.zip vs') (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup))
  have Hend : updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs = σ'' := by
    calc
      _ = updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks vs) ks' vs' := by
        simpa only [updatedStates] using (updatedStatesComm Hzip).symm
      _ = σ'' := by
        simpa only [← UpdateStatesUpdated Hup, ← InitStatesUpdated Hinit]
  exact ⟨updatedStates σ ks' vs', rfl,
    updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength Hinit)
      (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup)
      (InitStatesNodup Hinit), Hend ▸ Hupdate⟩

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  rw [funext_iff]
  by_contra! h
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := h
  let q : Y → ℝ := fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  have hq0 : 0 < q x₀ := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg'
      (Ne.symm (by simpa [inner_self_eq_zero'] using hx0))
  have hcont : Continuous q :=
    Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδ⟩ :=
    Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont.continuousAt (q x₀ / 2) (by linarith)
  have hpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ, 0 < q x := by
    intro x hx
    have hc := hδ (Metric.mem_ball.mp hx)
    rw [] at hc
    dsimp [q]
    linarith only [hq0, (abs_lt.mp hc).1]
  haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
  let φ1 : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, by positivity, by exact half_lt_self hδpos⟩
  let φ : Y → ℝ := φ1.toFun
  have hφ_testfun : IsTestFunction φ := ⟨φ1.contDiff, φ1.hasCompactSupport⟩
  have hφ_support_subset : Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ δ := by
    change Function.support φ1.toFun ⊆ _
    rw [ContDiffBump.support_eq]
  have key_integral := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀)
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right hφ_testfun contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key_integral
  have integrable_prod : Integrable (fun x => φ x * q x) μ :=
    (Continuous.mul hφ_testfun.smooth.continuous hcont).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      hφ_testfun.supp.mul_right
  have h_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * q x := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.support φ
    · exact mul_nonneg φ1.nonneg (hpos x (hφ_support_subset hx)).le
    · simp [Function.notMem_support.mp hx]
  have hμ : 0 < μ (Metric.ball x₀ (δ/2)) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos μ (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr (by positivity))
  have ball_subset_support : Metric.ball x₀ (δ/2) ⊆
      Function.support (fun x => φ x * q x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxδ : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hx
    simp only [Function.support_mul]
    exact ⟨ne_of_gt (φ1.pos_of_mem_ball hxδ), ne_of_gt (hpos x hxδ)⟩
  have integral_pos : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * q x ∂μ :=
    (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg h_nonneg integrable_prod).mpr
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hμ (measure_mono ball_subset_support))
  change (∫ x, φ x * q x ∂μ) = 0 at key_integral
  simpa [key_integral] using integral_pos

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  let E := A.electricField 𝓕.c t
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => E y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => E y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  let Ji : Time → ℝ := fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ Ji :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  calc _
    _ = ∂ₜ (fun t =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, Space.deriv j (fun x => magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c A t x (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * Ji t) t := by
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1]
          change fun t => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
          enter [t]
          rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
            (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
            time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∑ j, ∂ₜ (fun t => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t) -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (Ji) t := by
      rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub
        ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
        (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt]
      simp only [ FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply]
      rw [fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt]
      rw [fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
      simp only [Time.deriv_eq, FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · x (j, i)) t)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (Ji) t := by
      congr
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
      congr
      funext k
      rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv]
      apply magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff
      apply hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) *(∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (E · i) x -
        ∂[i] (E · j) x)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (Ji) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext k
        congr
        funext x
        rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
    _ = (1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (E · i) x) x -
          ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[i] (E · j) x) x)) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (Ji) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hEd _ _).differentiableAt (hEd _ _).differentiableAt]
        rfl
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (E · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[i] (E · j) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (Ji) t := by simp only [ Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (E · i) x) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[i] (fun x => ∂[j] (E · j) x) x) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (Ji) t := by
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs _)]
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (E · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (fun x => (∇ ⬝ (E)) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (Ji) t := by
        congr
        rw []
        change _ = fderiv ℝ (fun x => ∑ j, ∂[j] (E · j) x) x (Space.basis i)
        rw [fderiv_fun_sum]
        simp only [_root_.sum_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        intro j _
        exact (hEd j j).differentiableAt
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (E · i)) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀ ^ 2) * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (Ji) t := by
        congr 2
        rw [isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix] at h

        conv_lhs =>
          enter [2, 2, x]
          rw [(h t x).1]
        trans 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * Space.deriv i
            (fun x => (1/ 𝓕.ε₀) * LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity 𝓕.c J t x) x
        · congr
          funext x
          ring
        · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
          rw [fderiv_const_mul]
          simp only [ _root_.smul_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
          apply Differentiable.differentiableAt
          apply LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          exact hJ.differentiable (by decide)
        · exact hA
        · exact hJ
      _ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (E · i)) x) -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (Ji) t := by
          simp only [ FreeSpace.c_sq]
          field_simp

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change pb b (Basis.mem_span _ b)
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a* ofCrAnListF φs))
    change pa a (Basis.mem_span _ a)
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pa]
      let s := 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ)
      let r := List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)
      let tk := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c) r
      calc _
        /- Split the commutator. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
            crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
          s •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
          module
        /- Simplify the signs. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
          s •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
          rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
          module
        /- Splitting the time-ordered lists. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (tk)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (r))) -
          s •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (tk)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF
              (List.filter (fun c => decide (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (r)))) := by
          have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
            (by simp_all )
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp, h1]
          have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
            (by simp [hφψ, hψφ] )
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by norm_num, h2]
          repeat rw [ofCrAnListF_append]
          simp only [ map_mul,
    Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, s, r, tk]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF (tk)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              (ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) - s •
                ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (r)))) := by
            simp only [
    Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, mul_sub, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, sub_mul]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF (tk)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (r)))) := by
            congr
            rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
            simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul, s]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
      simp only [ List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, tk] at h1 ⊢
      rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (not_ne_iff.mp hq).symm,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, pa]
    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    rcases ih_l rfl l with val_l | ⟨t₁', red_l⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with val_r | ⟨t₂', red_r⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, u, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        exact .inr ⟨u ^ᵗᵗ t₂, .abs val_l.lc val_r⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨t₁.app t₂', .appᵣ val_l red_r⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨t₁'.app t₂, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l⟩
  case tapp σ' der sub ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
      exact .inr ⟨u ^ᵗᵞ σ', .tabs val.lc (by grind)⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨.tapp t' σ', .tapp (by grind) red⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der h ih _ =>
    have body : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, .let_body val body⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨t'.let' t₂, .let_bind red body⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · exact .inl (Value.inl val)
    · exact .inr ⟨.inl t', .inl red⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · exact .inl (Value.inr val)
    · exact .inr ⟨.inr t', .inr red⟩
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    have body₂ : t₂.body := by grind
    have body₃ : t₃.body := by grind
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · rcases der.canonical_form_sum val with ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩
      · cases val with
        | inl vu => exact .inr ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ u, .case_inl vu body₂ body₃⟩
      · cases val with
        | inr vu => exact .inr ⟨t₃ ^ᵗᵗ u, .case_inr vu body₂ body₃⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨t'.case t₂ t₃, .case red body₂ body₃⟩
  case sub => grind
  case abs σ _ τ L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.abs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind
  case tabs L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.tabs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁
  revert a₂
  induction h₁ <;> intro a₂ h₂
  case refl =>
    exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case par ha' hb' ih₁ ih₂ =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha' hb'⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      rcases ih₁ ha'' with ⟨a₃, ha, ha'₃⟩
      rcases ih₂ hb'' with ⟨b₃, hb, hb'₃⟩
      exact ⟨_, .par ha hb, .par ha'₃ hb'₃⟩
    case red_I =>
      cases I_irreducible _ ha'
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb'⟩
    case red_K x y =>
      obtain ⟨_, h', rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha'
      exact ⟨_, .red_K _ _, h'⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, ha, hc, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha'
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par ha hb') (.par hc hb')⟩
  case red_I =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    case par c a₁' hc ha =>
      cases I_irreducible c hc
      exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_K x y =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K _ _⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      obtain ⟨a₁', h', rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible x a' ha
      exact ⟨_, h', .red_K _ _⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_S x y z =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨a', b', ha, hb, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible x y d hd
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par ha hc) (.par hb hc), .red_S ..⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    constructor <;> intro s' htr <;> cases htr with
    | choiceL ht =>
      first
      | obtain ⟨s2', ht', hr'⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceL ht', .bisim hr'⟩
      | obtain ⟨s1', ht', hr'⟩ := h.follow_snd ht
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceL ht', .bisim hr'⟩
    | choiceR ht => exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    constructor <;> intro s' htr
    · obtain ⟨s2', htr', hr'⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
      exact ⟨s2', htr', .bisim hr'⟩
    · obtain ⟨s1', htr', hr'⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
      exact ⟨s1', htr', .bisim hr'⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 (⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩

  have h_d_i_gt_0 : d_i > 0 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, d_i]
    omega

  obtain ⟨g', h_g'_mem, h_g'_min_card⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw
    = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    let S := (fun g : C_i => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    have hS : S.Nonempty := Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty
    rcases Nat.sInf_mem hS with ⟨g, _, h⟩
    exact ⟨g.val, g.property, h.symm⟩

  have h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    change (Δ₀(f, g') : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d_fw * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rw [← ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    let ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    let _ : Fintype Y := Fintype.ofFinite Y
    let Φ : {x // x ∈ ΔH} → Y × Fin (2 ^ steps) := fun x =>
      (⟨iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x.val, by
        change ∃ z, iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps z =
          iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x.val ∧ f z ≠ g' z
        refine ⟨x.val, rfl, ?_⟩
        simpa only [ΔH, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using x.property⟩,
        pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (x := x.val))
    let F : Y × Fin (2 ^ steps) →
        sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ := fun p =>
      qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) (y := p.1.val) p.2
    have hrec (x : {x // x ∈ ΔH}) : F (Φ x) = x.val := by
      dsimp only [F, Φ]
      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
        (x := x.val) (y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps
          h_i_add_steps x.val)).mp rfl
    have hinj : Function.Injective Φ := by
      intro x z h
      exact Subtype.ext ((hrec x).symm.trans ((congrArg F h).trans (hrec z)))
    have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective Φ hinj
    rw [Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin] at hc
    calc
      _ ≤ Fintype.card Y * 2 ^ steps := hc
      _ = Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by rw [← _root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    exact (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g' h_g'_mem).trans
      h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size

  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)

  have h_algebraic_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one, d_i_plus_steps, d_i]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add]
    have hsub (a : ℕ) (ha : ↑i + steps ≤ a) :
        a - (↑i + steps) + steps = a - ↑i := by omega
    rw [hsub (ℓ + 𝓡) (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡)), hsub ℓ h_i_add_steps]

  have h_dH_ne_top : d_H ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at h_dist_bridge
    exact (not_le_of_gt (ENat.coe_lt_top (d_fw * 2 ^ steps))) h_dist_bridge

  let d_H_nat := ENat.toNat d_H
  have h_dH_eq : d_H = d_H_nat := (ENat.coe_toNat h_dH_ne_top).symm

  have h_final_inequality : 2 * d_H_nat ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    have h_bridge_nat : d_H_nat ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps :=
      ENat.coe_le_coe.mp (h_dH_eq ▸ h_dist_bridge)
    calc 2 * d_H_nat
      _ ≤ 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 h_bridge_nat
      _ = (2 * d_fw) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h_fw_bound
      _ = d_i - 1 := h_algebraic_identity

  simp only [d_H] at h_dH_eq
  rw [h_dH_eq]
  change ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ↑Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat <
    ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, by omega⟩)
  rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_pred (n := 2 * Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat) (m := d_i) (h := h_d_i_gt_0)
    h_final_inequality

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  simp only
  intro y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  set P_i := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) coeffs
  set new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw []
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1)) (i := 1)
      · omega
      · omega
    ⟩)
  have h_eval_qMap (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
      (x := fiberMap k) (y := y).mpr (by rw [pointToIterateQuotientIndex_qMap_total_fiber_eq_self])
    rw [h_res]
  have h_eval_qMap_x₀ : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval x₀.val = y := by
    simpa only [x₀] using h_eval_qMap 0
  have h_eval_qMap_x₁ : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval x₁.val = y := by
    simpa only [x₁] using h_eval_qMap 1
  have h_fiber_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    have h₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y (0 : Fin 2)
    have h₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y (1 : Fin 2)
    dsimp only at h₀ h₁
    dsimp only [x₁, fiberMap, x₀]
    rw [h₁, h₀]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, Submodule.coe_add,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_smul, zero_add, add_sub_cancel_right]
  set P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_P_i_eval := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs
  -- Equation 39 : P^(i)(X) = P₀^(i+1)(q^(i)(X)) + X · P₁^(i+1)(q^(i)(X))
  have h_equation_39_x₀ : P_i.eval x₀.val = P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, h_eval_qMap_x₀, Polynomial.eval_mul,
    Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  have h_equation_39_x₁ : P_i.eval x₁.val = P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, h_eval_qMap_x₁, Polynomial.eval_mul,
    Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  set f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) => P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  set f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  -- Unfold the definition of f_i_plus_1 using the fold function
  
  -- Main calculation following the outline
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = f_i x₀ * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        f_i x₁ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := rfl
    _ = P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by dsimp only
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
      rw [h_equation_39_x₀, h_equation_39_x₁]
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal + r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) +
        P₁.eval y.val * (x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
          x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val)) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * ((1 - r_chal) * (x₁.val - x₀.val)) +
        P₁.eval y.val * ((x₁.val - x₀.val) * r_chal) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [h_fiber_diff]; ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs]
      conv_lhs => enter [1]; rw [mul_comm, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul]
      conv_lhs => enter [2]; rw [mul_comm, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul]
      -- ⊢ eval y (C (1-r) * ∑...) + eval y (C r * ∑...) = eval y (∑...)
      rw [←Polynomial.eval_add]
      -- ⊢ poly_left.eval y = poly_right.eval y
      congr
      simp_rw [mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      -- We now prove that the terms inside the sums are equal for each index.
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      have h_j_lt : j.val < 2 ^ (ℓ - (↑i + 1)) := by
        rw [Nat.sub_add_eq]
        omega
      conv_lhs => enter [1]; rw [mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
        apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
          (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)⟩)), ←mul_assoc,
        mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal))]; rw [mul_assoc]
      conv_lhs => enter [2]; rw [mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
        apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
          (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)⟩)), ←mul_assoc,
        mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C r_chal)]; rw [mul_assoc]
      conv_rhs => rw [mul_comm]
      rw [←mul_add]
      congr
      simp only [← Polynomial.C_mul, ← Polynomial.C_add]

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
    classical
    intro ϑ
    induction ϑ with
    | zero =>
      intro u
      contradiction
    | succ ϑ_sub_1 ih =>
      cases ϑ_sub_1 with
      | zero =>
        simp only [zero_add, zero_lt_one, forall_const]
        intro u hprob_gt
        simp_rw [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation] at hprob_gt
        simp_rw [prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
          (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
          Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hprob_gt
        have h_correlated_agreement := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hprob_gt
        simp only [jointProximityNat₂] at h_correlated_agreement
        have h_u_eq: u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
          funext rowIdx
          fin_cases rowIdx <;> rfl
        rw [h_u_eq.symm] at h_correlated_agreement
        exact h_correlated_agreement
      | succ ϑ_sub_2 =>
        intro hϑ_gt_0 u hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        let ϑ_pred := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
        let m := 2 ^ ϑ_pred
        let U := splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_pred) u
        let U₀ := U.1
        let U₁ := U.2
        unfold jointProximityNat
        simp only
        have h_finsnoc_eq_r : ∀ r : Fin (ϑ_pred + 1) → F,
          Fin.snoc (fun i : Fin ϑ_pred => r i.castSucc)
            (r (Fin.last ϑ_pred)) = r := fun r => Fin.snoc_init_self r
        let hP_split_r_last := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
          (ϑ := ϑ_pred) (F := F)
          (P := fun r_last r_init =>
            Δ₀(multilinearCombine (u:=u) (r:=Fin.snoc r_init r_last), MC) ≤ e)
        simp_rw [h_finsnoc_eq_r] at hP_split_r_last
        rw [hP_split_r_last] at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        have multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine
          (r_init : Fin ϑ_pred → F) (r_last : F) : multilinearCombine u (Fin.snoc r_init r_last) =
            multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init := by
          rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form, Fin.snoc_last, Fin.init_snoc]
        simp_rw [multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine]
          at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        let R_star_set := R_star_tensor MC (m:=ϑ_pred) (e:=e) (ε:=ε) U₀ U₁
        have h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q := prob_R_star_gt_threshold
          (MC := MC) (ε := ε) (ϑ := ϑ_pred) (u := u) (e := e)
          hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        have h_line_close_to_C_m := correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor
          (ih := fun u_prev => ih (Nat.zero_lt_succ ϑ_sub_2) u_prev) (u := u)
        have h_C_m_gap := h_interleaved_gaps m (Nat.one_le_two_pow)
        let V₀ : Word (Fin m → A) ι :=
          ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin m) ι from U₀)
        let V₁ : Word (Fin m → A) ι :=
          ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin m) ι from U₁)
        let g := fun r : F => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u₀ := V₀)
          (u₁ := V₁) (r := r), (MC ^⋈ (Fin m))) ≤ e
        have h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q :
          Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[g r] > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
            have h_r_implies: ∀ (r : F), r ∈ R_star_set → g r := by
              intro r hr_in_Rstar
              specialize h_line_close_to_C_m ⟨r, hr_in_Rstar⟩
              unfold jointProximityNat at h_line_close_to_C_m
              assumption
            exact lt_of_le_of_lt' (Pr_le_Pr_of_implies (D := $ᵖ F)
              (g := g) (f := fun r => r ∈ R_star_set) (h_imp := h_r_implies))
              h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q
        have h_final_gap := h_C_m_gap (u₀ := V₀) (u₁ := V₁) h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q
        apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
        assumption

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  classical
  let f n := (u n, u (n+1), u (n+2), u (n+3))
  have hf : (Set.range f).Finite := Set.Finite.subset
    (Set.finite_Icc (B,B,B,B) (T,T,T,T)) (by
      rintro x ⟨n,rfl⟩
      simp only [mem_Icc, Prod.mk_le_mk, hB, and_self, f])
  have hp : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    obtain ⟨i,_,j,_,hne,heq⟩ :=
      Set.Infinite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_mapsTo Set.infinite_univ
        (Set.mapsTo_range f Set.univ) hf
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
    · exact ⟨i,j,h,heq⟩
    · exact ⟨j,i,h,heq.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨i,j,hij,hfij⟩ := hp
  have heq : u i = u j ∧ u (i+1) = u (j+1) ∧ u (i+2) = u (j+2) ∧ u (i+3) = u (j+3) := by
    simpa [f] using hfij
  have hs : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i+m) = u (j+m) ∧ u (i+m+1) = u (j+m+1) ∧
      u (i+m+2) = u (j+m+2) ∧ u (i+m+3) = u (j+m+3) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simpa using heq
    | succ m ih =>
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using ih.2.1
      · simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using ih.2.2.1
      · simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using ih.2.2.2
      · have ri := (hu (i+(m+4)) (by omega)).1
        have rj := (hu (j+(m+4)) (by omega)).1
        simp only [ zero_le, Nat.add_sub_assoc, Nat.add_one_sub_one, Nat.reduceLeDiff,
    Nat.reduceSub, add_tsub_cancel_right] at ri rj
        have hcast : (u (i+m) : ℝ) = u (j+m) ∧
            (u (i+(m+1)) : ℝ) = u (j+(m+1)) ∧
            (u (i+(m+2)) : ℝ) = u (j+(m+2)) ∧
            (u (i+(m+3)) : ℝ) = u (j+(m+3)) := by
          norm_cast
        have hreal : (u (i+(m+4)) : ℝ) = u (j+(m+4)) := by
          rw [ri, rj]
          simp only [hcast.2.2.2, hcast.2.2.1, hcast.2.1, hcast.1]
        exact_mod_cast hreal
  refine ⟨i, j-i, by omega, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have h := (hs (n-i)).1
  have hi : i+(n-i) = n := by omega
  have hj : j+(n-i) = n+(j-i) := by omega
  rw [hi,hj] at h
  exact h.symm

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hcomp : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ↔ Aᶜ ∉ P := by grind
  have hcard : P.card = Pᶜ.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bijective Set.compl compl_involutive.bijective
    intro A
    simpa using hcomp A
  have hsum : P.card + Pᶜ.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [Finset.card_add_card_compl, Fintype.card_set]
  have hp : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel Fintype.card_pos]
  omega

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have hreplace (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then y j else x j) =
        digits_to_num x + (y i - x i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      (∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then y j else x j) * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1) =
          ∑ j : Fin 9, (x j * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1 +
            (if j = i then y j - x j else 0) * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp only [hji, ↓reduceIte] <;> ring
      _ = (∑ j : Fin 9, x j * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1) +
          (y i - x i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp only [ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
  have hrel_dvd (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (hr : relation x y) :
      ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (y i - x i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + digits_to_num x := by
    intro i
    simpa only [hreplace, add_comm] using ((hrelation x y).mp hr).2 i
  have hde := hrel_dvd d e h.1
  have hef := hrel_dvd e f h.2
  have hdiff : digits_to_num e = digits_to_num d +
      ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    ring
  have hsum : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    have hs : 7 ∣ ∑ i : Fin 9,
        ((e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d) :=
      Finset.dvd_sum (fun i hi => hde i)
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hs
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hs
    have hm : 7 ∣ 7 * digits_to_num d := ⟨digits_to_num d, rfl⟩
    rw [hdiff]
    convert dvd_sub hs hm using 1 <;> ring
  have hprod : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    convert dvd_add (dvd_sub (hef i) hsum) (hde i) using 1 <;> ring
  intro i
  have hdiv : 7 ∣ f i - d i := by
    have hp : (7 : ℕ).Prime := by norm_num
    have hpow : ¬ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
      intro hx
      norm_cast at hx
      have : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hx
      norm_num at this
    rcases (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr
      (by norm_num : Nat.Prime (Int.natAbs (7 : ℤ)))).dvd_mul.mp (hprod i) with hfactor | hfactor
    · exact hfactor
    · exact False.elim (hpow hfactor)
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_add_rev, neg_neg, add_comm] using dvd_neg.mpr hdiv
